title: Bounded Complements for $\varepsilon-Log-Canonical$ Varieties
exact_target: For every dimension bound $d$ and $\varepsilon\geq 0$, does there exist a finite set of complementary indices $N_d(\varepsilon)$ such that every $\varepsilon$-log-canonical variety $X$ of dimension at most $d$, with $-K_X$ nef and big over $Z$, has a general bounded complement $(X,D/n)$ that is $\varepsilon$-log-canonical?
